name: Cryptonaut .001
description: The first Cryptonaut to land on the moon. .001 is the pioneer of the Cryptonauts, with the reliability and drive to maintain his head honcho status.

name: Cryptonaut .002
description: This Cryptonaut is on a mission. Staking claim, .002 is not afraid to make a mark on the universe. His life goal is to leave a legacy behind.

name: Cryptonaut .003
description: Building a better tomorrow takes vision, patience, and the courage to carry what matters most. .003 understands that true value is not measured by chance, but by what you choose to protect. This Cryptonaut knows the future is built from what others fail to see.

name: Cryptonaut .004
description: Hard to overlook, impossible to ignore. With a spark of purpose and endless drive, .004 carries the charge that keeps progress moving. This Cryptonaut knows energy is more than power, it’s the force that turns vision into action.

name: Cryptonaut .005
description: Always willing to share oxygen with the other Cryptonauts, .005 is a warm Cryptonaut. She gives good, and gets better. It's clear the universe matches vibrations.

name: Cryptonaut .006
description: The law of gravity has got this Cryptonaut's back. It must be because .006 is determined to make the best out of whatever is given to her. She eases through life flowing with the wind.

name: Cryptonaut .007
description: A practical Cryptonaut who knows it's better to be safe than sorry. .007 is a major tech genius who is always willing to help others with their computer woes.

name: Cryptonaut .008
description: .008 is extremely resourceful. He takes only what he needs and ensures others are not wasteful (good thing he is funny, otherwise this could get annoying.) With a feeling of just the right amount of minerals to extract, this Cryptonaut has a sense of how much the universe is comfortable sharing with the Cryptonauts.

name: Cryptonaut .009
description: .009 can sometimes be in his own world, which is why many find him funny. However, little do they know, he has crafted a universe in his mind where only beauty and opportunity exit. Though he physically lives in reality, he is mentally in this idyllic place, making him one of the most positive Cryptonauts to walk the moon.

name: Cryptonaut .010
description: This Cryptonaut is on a mission and will not stop till he gets there. .010 can go the distance, but will always figure out the quickest way to get there. Ready to adjust speed, breath, or direction, .010 is ready for whatever he may run into along the way.

name: Cryptonaut .011
description: Catch this Cryptonaut at the market with coffee in hand, talking a mile a minute, chatting everyone's ear off. The only reason .011 gets away with it is because he's hilarious and clever.

name: Cryptonaut .012
description: The most charitable Cryptonaut, always looking for ways to give. Whether it's making balloon animals for the moon babies or grooming the moon creatures, .012 is one altruistic Cryptonaut.

name: Cryptonaut .013
description: A cultured, free spirit. .013 lives the life of a true artist. Blessed with a unique vision and the skills to translate it to the canvas, this Cryptonaut is certainly the most open minded.

name: Cryptonaut .014
description: .014 knows just the right way to build those gains. He is a technique master with a flawless physique and wakes up early to maintain this. This control is applied to all areas of his life.

name: Cryptonaut .015
description: Most of this Cryptonaut's life happens in his dreams, which is why he would always rather be sleeping. The universe delivers messages to .015 in his slumber and he honours this by putting himself in the state to receive them.

name: Cryptonaut .016
description: .016 has an affinity for all things natural. A socially responsible Cryptonaut who reminds others to practice conscientiousness and care when it comes to the environment.

name: Cryptonaut .017
description: With extreme discipline, .017 has perfected the martial arts. He uses his talents with discretion as it is never for violence, but only to keep him in top shape both physically and mentally.

name: Cryptonaut .018
description: The life of the party who knows how to dance to the rhythm of the universe. .018's laid back, fun-loving attitude is all part of his allure.

name: Cryptonaut .019
description: You've always got to be on your toes when you spend most of your life six feet in the air. That's why .019 is ready for whatever. His certainty that he'll make the jump keeps him from falling flat on his face.

name: Cryptonaut .020
description: .020 is ready to go wherever his jet pack may lead him. He takes on new adventure with open arms and a certainty that all will turn out well.

name: Cryptonaut .021
description: .021 is a brilliant explorer-type. She won't be quoting the dated health advice, "an apple a day keeps the doctor away". This Cryptonaut is always on the search for the newest discoveries of the human body, as she's on a mission to expand human knowledge.

name: Cryptonaut .022
description: The Cryptonauts can always count on .022 to fix anything. With his inquisitive mind and eager to learn mentality, this Cryptonaut is constantly making the wrong go right.

name: Cryptonaut .023
description: Expansion of civilization on the moon all comes down to determination and accountability for .023. This Cryptonaut is the leader of new development for a reason- he won't rest till they reach civilization's peak.

name: Cryptonaut .024
description: Development always requires a balance in one's approach, and that is what .024 brings to the table. He has lofty goals for the Cryptonaut's side of the moon, but understands humans must develop with respect to the land and those there before them.

name: Cryptonaut .025
description: This Cryptonaut is relaxed in his approach to fishing and life. For .025 this includes an unwavering belief that the prime catch is just around the corner.

name: Cryptonaut .026
description: For this Cryptonaut, music is the ultimate way to rid of the ego. With an ability to escape himself in the rhythm, .026 is graced with the knowledge that he is just a fraction of a moment in all of eternity. His headphones bring him this freeing realization.

name: Cryptonaut .027
description: With the talent of Robinhood, .027 never misses. She is always aware of her surroundings and anything that can affect the arrow's course, which is how this Cryptonaut is in every area of her life.

name: Cryptonaut .028
description: With extreme concentration, .028 never misses his target. There can be a meteor shower going on around him and his eye will still be on the ball. Tee up, set sight, and celebrate that hole in one.

name: Cryptonaut .029
description: .029 is as predictable as the rain in spring. Never without his telescope, this Cryptonaut feels an obligation to the universe to explore every inch of it.

name: Cryptonaut .030
description: .030 is always in good spirits, especially knowing opportunity is never far behind. Carrying a bag full of potential, this Cryptonaut moves with confidence and trusts every choice made along the way.

name: Cryptonaut .031
description: This Cryptonaut has got one thing and one thing only on her mind - what others overlook. .031 knows the value hidden beneath the surface and honors the patience it takes to uncover fossils long forgotten. In her hands, the past is always worth discovering.

name: Cryptonaut .032
description: A real punster who enjoys a little drink now and then. His sometimes-chaotic energy is balanced by .032's sense of trust in something greater than himself.

name: Cryptonaut .033
description: Determined to get to the top, .033 has 360-degree awareness for anything that can possibly stop him- or any rocks coming down the mountain.

name: Cryptonaut .034
description: Always ready to bring out the guitar for an impromptu party, .034 is a real entertainer. This Cryptonaut is prepared for anything because you never know when someone is going to need a killer riff.

name: Cryptonaut .035
description: Good thing .035 has got the brains and trustworthiness to deal with something as dangerous as electricity. It takes great dependableness to handle live wires. No forks in the socket for this guy; safety comes first.

name: Cryptonaut .036
description: .036 is all about the simplest, most satisfying way to achieve something. He's a no fuss kind of Cryptonaut who's a real comedian.

name: Cryptonaut .037
description: .037 is a Cryptonaut of high standards. Keeping his two homes -his body and environment-clean is how he cares and appreciates them both. Usually, those around him find his uptight behaviour irritating, but .037 simply pokes back with a smart remark.

name: Cryptonaut .038
description: Video games have taught .038 to be ready for anything and to adjust accordingly. This Cryptonaut is not a typical hide-in-the-basement gamer. She is super popular and will make any stranger a friend.

name: Cryptonaut .039
description: .039 is a born guardian with a natural sense of authority. The group can feel safe and at ease, knowing this Cryptonaut has security handled. Additionally, his manly musk is irresistible to those around him.

name: Cryptonaut .040
description: .040 is the type of Cryptonaut who can make anyone feel like the most special person in the universe, as she sings into their eyes. With the voice of an angel, this songbird draws those around her in to appreciate the simplistic beauty of song.

name: Cryptonaut .041
description: .041 has the ability to see the final product before she even touches her tools. This Cryptonaut is a visionary who wastes no time when it comes to bringing her ideas to life.

name: Cryptonaut .042
description: .042 is always looking for answers under her microscope. With the belief she is just one microbe away from a universe shattering discovery, this Cryptonaut is committed to reaching a conclusion. However, she is always open to various hypotheses along the way.

name: Cryptonaut .043
description: .043 is not afraid to put his back into it. This Cryptonaut is driven to win but is certainly never a sore loser. He has class and charm, even when the competition is tight.

name: Cryptonaut .044
description: This Cryptonaut may not know exactly where he is going, but that's how the most worthwhile discoveries are made. Always ready to redirect himself, .044 is a true explorer at heart.

name: Cryptonaut .045
description: The zen Cryptonaut who offers her infinite serenity to the gang when they need it most. .045 is perhaps one of the most enlightened of the bunch, but in a no-brag, humble way.

name: Cryptonaut .046
description: Not entirely sure where her parachute will take her, .046 is happy to explore wherever it is. The only thing she is certain of is that she is one of the greatest explorers to walk the moon.

name: Cryptonaut .047
description: .047 is always doing things to make others laugh. This Cryptonaut is a happy- go-lucky Cryptonaut who approaches life with her arms wide open (in 3 feet of snow).

name: Cryptonaut .048
description: A Cryptonaut who redefines luxury. With oozing intelligence and an alluring persona, .048 is seemingly unaware of his own grandeur.

name: Cryptonaut .049
description: With child-like innocence, .049's pull is her ability to enjoy the moment. This Cryptonaut doesn't let overthinking ruin anything as she's here for a good time, not a long time. Good thing her kindness offers balance to this lackadaisical attitude.

name: Cryptonaut .050
description: Timing is everything and .050 always has enough patience for the perfect time's arrival. This Cryptonaut knows things have a way of working themselves out, so he waits with a mixture of ease and excitement for his coming fortunes.

name: Cryptonaut .051
description: A true guardian at heart. .051 has enough self-restraint, control, and vision to protect the entire galaxy, let alone the moon.

name: Cryptonaut .052
description: There is a lot to be learned from the ants, one of the strongest species in the world. For instance, an unwavering belief in the self, adaptability, and a strong conviction that all will turn out better than okay. That’s why .052 is such a force to be reckoned with- she does as she observes.

name: Cryptonaut .053
description: Intelligence and compassion like .053’s cannot be bought, even with all the TTM coins in the universe. Luckily, he’s already got a great deal of both and is always down to share and spread the good.

name: Cryptonaut .054
description: There’s no need to lose it when you always know the way. And if you don’t, you’ll make it work even better than imagined. .054 finds blessings down every path she takes and knows it.

name: Cryptonaut .055
description: A real handyman who knows his way around any moon tool. .055 is aware of the beauty of his surroundings and only uses his skills when necessary to protect the environment.

name: Cryptonaut .056
description: Hailing from the financial core of an earthly city, this business man is tied to his ventures. .056 is a smart Cryptonaut with great certainty.

name: Cryptonaut .057
description: Not every recipe goes as planned, but that doesn’t matter when you’re this good at what you do. .057 is the perfect combination of skill, readiness and passion- *Chef’s kiss!*

name: Cryptonaut .058
description: Staying true to her roots, everyone can always count on .058 to make a beautiful sound that comes from years of practice. She is always willing to share a good ol’ traditional Oran.

name: Cryptonaut .059
description: Chess is a game of speed, intellect and strategy. That’s why .059 is the real queen of the chessboard. Care for a match?

name: Cryptonaut .060
description: A child-like wonder, anchored by an eye set on target will take you to extraordinary depths one could only dream of reaching. .060’s need to discover is the air that powers his scuba tank, as he explores the open waters.

name: Cryptonaut .061
description: Carrying the need to share an untold story within her, .061 is quick-witted and creative beyond belief. While her vocab may be complex, she is a simple soul.

name: Cryptonaut .062
description: This earnest Cryptonaut shares his funny with the universe the best way he knows how- through his laptop. .062 is a viral content creator who has all the cryptonauts tuned in to his channel, waiting for their daily dose of laughs.

name: Cryptonaut .063
description: Always willing to get herself where she needs to be to capture the perfect shot. .063 has an eye for not only what, but when to take the pic. Her artistic charm oozes through her work.

name: Cryptonaut .064
description: The quickest fingers of the universe, taking over the GameFi space. .064’s persistence and readiness make him the best gamer of the entire universe.

name: Cryptonaut .065
description: With focus as sharp as his sword, .065 has the humbleness and tenacity to be the universe’s ultimate sword master. This samurai will not back down.

name: Cryptonaut .066
description: A little mystery never hurt anyone, especially not .066 because he knows he’ll crack the case wide open. Ever heard of the case of the missing lithium moon rocks? Probably not because it was solved in no time. This detective is always willing to volunteer his services.

name: Cryptonaut .067
description: Curious to know what happens when you mix Moon Pear Seeds with GAS? Just ask .067 because she’s already done it all. Her one-track mind is balanced by her steady, focused process, making her a remarkable chemist.

name: Cryptonaut .068
description: Kick back, relax, and just sink in. .068 is always down for a lounge- and a laugh. She always manages to keep the good times going with her cheerful demeanor and magnetism.

name: Cryptonaut .069
description: This outgoing Cryptonaut feels his way to properly caring for his trees. He knows all about their roots, stems and leaves… the process of aerobic respiration…how they use CO2 to make oxygen… .069 is determined to grow the most fertile marijuana trees for the entire universe.

name: Cryptonaut .070
description: No weapons, just skill. .070’s agility and awareness make him a Judo master. There’s no sneaking up behind this Cryptonaut…Ready, set, randori!

name: Cryptonaut .071
description: No hitting below the belt here. .071 takes care to give nothing but a fair match. Why wouldn’t he when he has an unwavering faith in himself and his vigilance.

name: Cryptonaut .072
description: Every Cryptonaut loves to visit the kind butcher. With her clever zingers and gentle nature, .072 uses her knife to chop and share! There is always more than enough at this butcher’s shop.

name: Cryptonaut .073
description: Got to move the GAS and Lithium Moon Rocks from A to B somehow. Luckily, .073 is all about keeping to the process and not wasting any resources. His down-to-earth character has made him a go-to for safe transportation of naturally occurring valuables of the moon.

name: Cryptonaut .074
description: This snow bunny is certain she’ll be the first at the foot of the moon mountain. The only thing slowing .074 down is her little detours to explore off the beaten paths. Cross-country skiing anyone?

name: Cryptonaut .075
description: Not exactly the type that can be rented for kid’s birthday parties… .075 has too much natural feeling, confidence and charm for a distracted audience like that. This magician is a proper showman and the headlining act, so, step right up and see the great and powerful .075!

name: Cryptonaut .076
description: In a very Rockstar-esque way, .076 is the center of attention. His ability to play the drums like no one else and outgoingness may be what draws people into the party, but it’s his humanity and sweetness that keep them there.

name: Cryptonaut .077
description: .077 has got her tokens locked and loaded. With that striking tenacity and boldness, softened by her grace, she won’t be dialing the combination for just any opportunity that comes her way.

name: Cryptonaut .078
description: .078 is the perfect example of how reading builds intelligence and humor. The only problem is trying to get him to look up from his book and throw some of that banter, but that just proves his commitment to his work as the moon’s leader in literary research.

name: Cryptonaut .079
description: This old soul reminds the other Cryptonauts that no matter how far development on the moon goes, they must stay humble and that sometimes, going back to basics pays off. Side note- .079’s charm also helps him win this argument.

name: Cryptonaut .080
description: .080 knows when to hold ‘em and when to fold ‘em. His belief in himself and ability to play whatever cards he is dealt, is all part of what draws others to him.

name: Cryptonaut .081
description: Always willing to share a nice cold one, .081 is the friend that is sure to be there. He will always lend an ear over a pint or two. Just be ready for an adventure later on- drinking puts him in an explorative mood.

name: Cryptonaut .082
description: These are not your Grandma’s mittens. .082’s knitting creations are utilitarian works of art. Her pieces are used by all on the moon to promote the 3 R’s- Reduce, Reuse, Recycle! Not to mention she’s a machine and gets everything done in no time.

name: Cryptonaut .083
description: A serene stream, steady as she goes. .083 may be up in the air on a rope, but she’s as grounded as they come. Everyone can count on her, no matter how high up she decides to walk.

name: Cryptonaut .084
description: Keeper of public notices, this Cryptonaut’s trustworthiness and enthusiasm makes him the best man for the job. .084 is a bit of a stickler, but no one seems to notice or at least mind because of his ability to make everyone laugh.

name: Cryptonaut .085
description: No retirements on his watch. .085 is a racer who knows the track like the back of his hand. And as if that’s not enough, his sureness of himself and humor certainly make up for it.

name: Cryptonaut .086
description: This Queen of the Grill is the ultimate pitmaster. .086 is so good at what she does that no one can tell it’s not actual meat. Her ethical cooking has all the cryptonauts lining up for seconds!

name: Cryptonaut .087
description: This ballerina nails the entire choreography in one-go. With the grace of a moon swan .087 draws others to her and honors all other dancers, regardless of her genius.

name: Cryptonaut .088
description: Had a rough day? Have a jump with .088 and get the good vibes flowing. She’s a real wise-cracker who is more than happy to jump rope with anyone who’s in need of those feel-good endorphins.

name: Cryptonaut .089
description: As if there wasn’t already enough of a lack of gravity on the moon….but maybe it’s the irony of it all that makes .089 such a hilarious guy. He’s always willing to share some air on his trampoline.

name: Cryptonaut .090
description: With an impeccable taste in music, .090 knows the best of every genre. You ask for it, he’s got it! This Cryptonaut makes all the moon beats for the universe to enjoy and serves them with a side of warmth and passion that no other entertainer does.

name: Cryptonaut .091
description: Of course, .091 is always at ease - he’s carrying more than most can imagine. Radiating positivity and quiet confidence, this Cryptonaut knows true treasures are found among the stars and kept safe in the bag.

name: Cryptonaut .092
description: Master of the curve shot, .092 gets every ball into the pocket. This must be from his clever and quick nature. An approachable guy, always down for a game who keeps everyone laughing with his tricks.

name: Cryptonaut .093
description: Ready to go wherever life takes her, .093 is always ready for a whimsical adventure. But open her suitcase and you’ll see she only carries the basic essentials and does not let frivolous objects slow her down. This Cryptonaut is all about the experience!

name: Cryptonaut .094
description: Good luck getting an appointment with the moon’s top hair stylist. .094 is a master artist who stays true to the rules of styling- No rounded bangs on a diamond face! But part of his appeal is his appreciation for his clients, as he never takes his business for granted.

name: Cryptonaut .095
description: The Universe’s resident Moon Cave Specialist. This speleologist has a one-track mind set on reaching depths of caves no one even knows exist! And also, in record-breaking time no one even knows is possible! The need to find what lies inside in the depths is what drives .095 on his journey.

name: Cryptonaut .096
description: A creative soul who prefers to do his work in peace. That’s why .096 is an artist of the night. Though not many see him around, they have all come to appreciate his meaningful work.

name: Cryptonaut .097
description: The most gracious show-stopper you’ll ever meet. Regardless of his talent .097 is as unpretentious as they come and he is loved all the more for it.

name: Cryptonaut .098
description: The only thing more fun than flying a kite on a windy day on earth, is flying one on the moon. .098 knows what’s good. It’s all fun and games when you are this campy and big-hearted!

name: Cryptonaut .099
description: Catch her at the Moonporium taking advantage of the best deals. .099 is a passionate couponer, always looking to discover the best finds tokens can buy.

name: Cryptonaut .100
description: Some call it being in the right place at the right time, others call it a coincidence, but somehow, this Cryptonaut always manages to discover the most valuable runes of the moon’s surface. Fortunately for him, no one is jealous of his riches and are instead drawn to him because of .100’s pure nature.

name: Cryptonaut .101
description: This enlightened Cryptonaut seeks the more bucolic side of the moon. Find .101 hidden amongst the serene mountains, absorbing all the knowledge a Cryptonaut can.

name: Cryptonaut .102
description: 90's nostalgia anyone? You may think the boom box is passe, but .102 is bringing it back and this time, to the moon. This Cryptonaut is full of good vibes and uses creativity to liven up any lackluster space.

name: Cryptonaut .103
description: Make love, not war. .103 is one gentle soul whose unwavering belief carries this flower child through life. Just like the flower, this Cryptonaut is sewn to the environment around it.

name: Cryptonaut .104
description: The quick movements of .104 are nearly invisible to the naked eye. This martial arts master is ready to adjust based on the threat before her. She has a talent for anticipation. Though .104 could, she would never hurt another and only utilizes her talents when defense is necessary.

name: Cryptonaut .105
description: Probably the moon's toughest bouncer- there will be no casual entry into the vault on .105's watch. There is a certain vision to his work as he feels out who's in it for the long run and who's not. And if you're a dumper- Access denied!

name: Cryptonaut .106
description: This is one smooth Cryptonaut. .106 has the skills to dance his way through any obstacle with incredible energy and passion. Swerve.

name: Cryptonaut .107
description: With the natural ability to sense what lies beyond the thick surface of the moon, .107 is never short of direction. This Cryptonaut knows the way and with blessings from the universe gets it right every time.

name: Cryptonaut .108
description: You can always count on this resourceful soul to help things grow. .108 keeps his focus on the future and won’t stop watering progress until every mission blooms.

name: Cryptonaut .109
description: This Cryptonaut's child-like wonder is what keeps him tied to a virtual reality of his own. You'd think .109 lives in another world and therefore exemplifies the more absent-minded qualities a human can have, but on the contrary, he has the tenacity and intelligence of the most apprehensive beings of the entire universe.

name: Cryptonaut .110
description: This expert of espionage will contort his way through any crevice. .110 is a compassionate Cryptonaut, who uses his shuriken (throwing stars) as a delaying tactic, not to pierce his opponents.

name: Cryptonaut .111
description: .111 moves with air in the tank and no fear in the step. When the mission calls for extra oxygen, he’s already in motion. Others try to match this charge-ahead energy, but can’t replicate this Cryptonauts unique spark.

name: Cryptonaut .112
description: If anyone should be the gang's main source of spiritual illumination, it's .112. With her magnetic, bright energy, this Cryptonaut can handle revealing the path to enlightenment. Think not of her as a teacher, but simply a revealer.

name: Cryptonaut .113
description: You have to have complete trust in the universe when you're falling 14,000 feet through the galaxy sky. All his successful jumps and lands on the moon's surface have made .113 one self- assured, outgoing Cryptonaut.

name: Cryptonaut .114
description: The diploma is a symbol of tenacity and maturity as it reminds one of the years of effort traded off for being called up to the podium. .114 represents these same virtues as she has the discipline to reach any goal, academic or not. Hats off, Grad!

name: Cryptonaut .115
description: You would think he was a greedy Cryptonaut, but on the contrary loves to share his most beloved dishes and is always down to make merry around the table. Believe it or not, he is also a vegetarian who promotes a green lifestyle. Bon Appetit!

name: Cryptonaut .116
description: Discipline does not dull .116’s natural charm or sharp humor. He’s a lively presence who pilots every mission with style and precision. Need direction through uncertain skies? Just ask the Cryptonauts’ trusted aviator to lead the way.

name: Cryptonaut .117
description: You just know .117 will catch the ball, no matter how high or extravagant the toss is. As predictable as a machine, this Cryptonaut has plenty of talent but will never be the one to brag about it- a true entertainer at heart.

name: Cryptonaut .118
description: Kick back, relax, and enjoy the lull. .118 certainly has this sequence mastered. Without a care in the world, this Cryptonaut knows all will turn out as it should, as long as one focuses on and contributes to the good.

name: Cryptonaut .119
description: Can you keep up? .119 certainly can. Always ready to serve up something better than the last round, this Cryptonaut won’t leave the pan until the job is done. Unless, of course, friends are nearby - then the only thing being cooked is a good time.

name: Cryptonaut .120
description: A bit of a daredevil. Spends most of his time making his wrongs, right. .120's focus is to live it up, even if that means paying for it later. But this bad boy is harmless with his only crime being trying to keep the gang in stitches.

name: Cryptonaut .121
description: A truly generous soul. .121 always considers the future generations and what will be left for them. She understands that good things (like vegetation and organic foods) take time to grow, yet continues to display selflessness through her dedication to caring for Cryptonauts she may never meet.

name: Cryptonaut .122
description: Good luck spectating a match with .122 playing. You won't even spot the ball because of her quick drives and smashes. Many believe she can accurately play out the entire game in her head before reaching the table for first serve. This Cryptonaut's grit is simply remarkable and unmatchable!

name: Cryptonaut .123
description: .123 definitely holds the most life experience after living out many full years, but does not act like the senior he is. His zest for life, combined with all the lessons he's learned make him one of the most popular and interesting Cryptonauts, especially amongst the youth!

name: Cryptonaut .124
description: This Cryptonaut loves to be suspended mid air, even if it's only to dangle and hang. .124 is the first to reach any destination, but does so while maintaining an ease to her technique.

name: Cryptonaut .125
description: Put your hands up and enjoy the way down! .125 is all about the feeling in her stomach when she lets gravity do its job. Her playful, engaging attitude feeds her need-to-discover way of life.

name: Cryptonaut .126
description: This courteous Cryptonaut serves sincerity on a silver platter. .126 is the most gracious host who is a magnet to those around him, not because of his hospitality, but because of his massive heart.

name: Cryptonaut .127
description: .127 understands a solid base comes from hardworking, steady hands. This Cryptonaut always delivers great work, on time, making her one of the best builders on the moon.

name: Cryptonaut .128
description: This creative soul maintains her playfulness and innocence through seeking pleasure in the simple things of life. .128 is a whimsical character who's sure to blow everyone away!

name: Cryptonaut .129
description: When lifting this heavy, one must be sensible and accountable for the goal set out to reach. This is what makes .129 one the greatest lifters the moon has ever seen. He is steadfast, yet ensures to always have a spotter nearby.

name: Cryptonaut .130
description: Ready to reach heights no one has reached before! .130 is prepared for whatever size rock the mountain may send tumbling his way. This explorer has a goal to touch every snow-brushed peak and see every breathtaking view.

name: Cryptonaut .131
description: .131 is all about going with the flow. Only once he reaches full acceptance of the stream's movement, can he readjust to any obstacles in the way. Along with the path of least resistance, this Cryptonaut understands the ebbs of generosity- what you give is what you get.

name: Cryptonaut .132
description: The moon's resident stuntman loves to set his sight on impossible heights and reach them. .132 is sure of himself, but even when he doesn't make the ollie, shows the values of a true sportsman.

name: Cryptonaut .133
description: In the blink of an eye, watch her vanish into the horizon with her killer front stroke. This Cryptonaut can make a speed boat look like a lazy duck cruising its way down the river. .133's gusto for and passion for life seep through her perma-mood of whimsicality.

name: Cryptonaut .134
description: Cryptonauts line up for miles outside his shop, even if it's just to get a whiff of his famous cornbread. With a heart of gold, it's hard for .134 to not have enough for everyone but his baked goods are just too irresistible to be able to keep up with the demand. Luckily, his bakery assistants help him out a bit, so he can still charm the crowds while maintaining his jolly Ol' town baker status.

name: Cryptonaut .135
description: The job of the farmer is no joke. .135 is up before the sun and still tending to the crops long after it disappears for the day. Fortunately, this Cryptonaut understands the value of hard work and how the payoff only multiplies with time.

name: Cryptonaut .136
description: No melancholy pieces here. This prodigy's song will turn a dark day into the brightest meteor shower and her personality will do the same. .136 is quite a phenomenon of the moon.

name: Cryptonaut .137
description: You may think .137 does nothing but sweep the same spot all day, but no corner of the universe escapes this Cryptonaut’s notice. This sharp-minded soul always finds the bright side and keeps every path clear for others. So regardless of all that gets stirred up, .137 could never be called anything but a force for good.

name: Cryptonaut .138
description: Not sure if you heard, but tradespeople are always in demand on the moon. It's not easy to arrange for one's services and if you do, they may not show up because they are requested at a bigger job elsewhere, but not this craftsman, wherever he commits to be, he'll be. .138 is ready to work and his word is as solid as wood.

name: Cryptonaut .139
description: Gather around the fire with this zany Cryptonaut. .139 always has a hilarious campfire story to share. Basically, if you ever get an invite to join her, you'd be crazy not to…and don't worry about the marshmallows- she's literally got a life supply! S'mores up!

name: Cryptonaut .140
description: The real Iron Man. People say .140 has hands of gold that form the most incredible objects and can withstand such extreme temperatures-bare! Maybe that's the secret as to how quick he works. Also, if ever in need of a laugh, sit in at his shop. This Cryptonaut loves to spew jokes while crafting.

name: Cryptonaut .141
description: It takes plenty of vision to see beyond the blob of clay .141 begins molding with. Only through this vision can she make the most incredible ceramics with intricate designs. Her hands are her guide as she quietly observes the way they want to move. The decorative artist is nothing but a vessel according to this Cryptonaut.

name: Cryptonaut .142
description: .142 is ready to scour the sea and observe life through his binoculars. This Cryptonaut is prepared for whatever the blue may bring and always keeps on his toes. All aboard the SS Exploration!

name: Cryptonaut .143
description: This lovable Cryptonaut always puts together the most elaborate, plush arrangements. It is mostly because she doesn't use her flowers sparingly. .143 will go above and beyond and even include extra to provide the full, elegant effect.

name: Cryptonaut .144
description: A very honest Cryptonaut who will share the true worth of every jewel. .144 is the farthest thing from a trickster who wants to rip someone off. His honesty, kindness and passion for his work has made him the number one jeweler on the moon. Planning to pop the question anytime soon?

name: Cryptonaut .145
description: Always looking for the next fossil or rune to discover, .145 is a major advocate of making the most of the land, but with the utmost respect. He is currently working to minimize the environmental impact on construction machinery used on the moon. Not to mention, this Cryptonaut is a hoot to hang with, so if you're ever down for cleaning artifacts, you're in for a good time.

name: Cryptonaut .146
description: Want to see your colony at 10,000 ft? Just say the word and .146 will take you there. There's no place she won't go, regardless if it seems too far, or high. This thrillseeker simply wants to see the universe from remarkable coordinates and laugh the entire time doing it. Now you know why everyone loves her company.

name: Cryptonaut .147
description: "When in doubt, let your horse do the thinking." .147's admiration and bond with horses began at a young age and hasn't stopped growing since. When not on his horse, he's yarnin' the hours away at the saloon telling tales of the Old West!

name: Cryptonaut .148
description: It's rare to find this acrobat in an upright position. But in whichever orientation you meet her, this Cryptonaut's warm soul will always shine through. .148 is eager to share her skills and teach admirers technique.

name: Cryptonaut .149
description: The moon's resident film buff. .149 is an easygoing Cryptonaut who enjoys sitting back and watching the classics. His extensive knowledge in cinema is what makes this Cryptonaut such a clever, quick conversationalist with brilliant references.

name: Cryptonaut .150
description: Always hitting the double bull, there is no one more accurate than .150. It's fascinating to witness his laser-sharp focus the moment before he throws. Just be sure to keep quiet because no one dares to disturb the billiards master.

name: Cryptonaut .151
description: .151 knows a true ruler is one who believes he is worthy to govern the group. Opinions of sheep aside, it's time to claim the throne.

name: Cryptonaut .152
description: Ready for whatever threat is hiding around the corner, .152 is precise beyond belief. This Cryptonaut finds joy where others usually face fear- in meeting the unknown.

name: Cryptonaut .153
description: Up before some even call it a day, .153 knows that others rely on her to show up and she simply can’t let them down. A woman of her word, this Cryptonaut will never let one of her animals go astray.

name: Cryptonaut .154
description: This master of tactic is prepared to reroute at any point. .154 has the universe on his side and treats others with dignity as a way to pay it back for that.

name: Cryptonaut .155
description: An unshakeable Cryptonaut with the ability to maintain composure in the most heated of situations. .155 holds his stance and is determined to stay that way.

name: Cryptonaut .156
description: An earnest Cryptonaut, eager to keep the crowd in tears- of laughter that is! .156 is always ready for a show and his puppets are a tool to bring the group closer together.

name: Cryptonaut .157
description: .157 is always working on maximizing her physical and mental potential, so rest assured she can defend the group at a moment's notice. It’s just not recommended you sneak up on this Cryptonaut, especially while she's drilling. Hey, she’s only human after all.

name: Cryptonaut .158
description: Only someone as controlled and on guard as .158 can handle the precision necessary to use this tool. This Cryptonaut knows what's in his hands is anything but a toy.

name: Cryptonaut .159
description: Always able to find something worth laughing about, .159 will eagerly make do with whatever gets thrown her way. Never underestimate the jester- she is no fool.

name: Cryptonaut .160
description: .160 is a skilled sorcerer who knows all the tricks to have everyone swooning. But it’s not all about wowing the group, this wiz is smart enough to use his powers for the greater good of all Cryptonauts.

name: Cryptonaut .161
description: An ancient Egyptian ruler that knows you have to be quick on your feet to wear the Nemes on your head. That’s why .161 keeps his banter game strong.

name: Cryptonaut .162
description: .162 is capable of marching the distance of the moon, no problem. Along with that, this legionary can throw or thrust his spear in any direction- just say charge.

name: Cryptonaut .163
description: A leader from a great ancient dynasty, .163 does not rule with an iron fist, but instead with compassion for others and flexibility in his approach. The Mughals are known for their contribution to architecture and this Cryptonaut is no different with his help to shape the urban landscape on the moon.

name: Cryptonaut .164
description: Just like her ancestors, .164 is always asking the important philosophical questions. Her capability of higher- order thinking makes this Cryptonaut very alluring to others. Got big questions regarding our existence, this girl is always ready to talk it out.

name: Cryptonaut .165
description: Always among the first to find new land on the moon, .165 and his horned helmet are capable of handling the terrain. Adventure is always just around the corner for this Cryptonaut.

name: Cryptonaut .166
description: The inventor of futuristic agricultural practices on the moon. .166 uses his Mayan roots to better the Cryptonaut’s relationship with the land. Ethical harvesting is this Cryptonaut’s main goal.

name: Cryptonaut .167
description: A U-shaped magnet, attracting all good things, .167 is secure in himself and his ability to talk to the right people at the right time. A bit of a schmoozer, but it’s all okay when it's for the greater good of the Cryptonauts.

name: Cryptonaut .168
description: Imagine being so creative you could see the notes before you play them. .168 can do just that. But just because she’s a musical genius doesn’t mean her mind lives far away in la la land. No, this Cryptonaut is as present and grounded as they come.

name: Cryptonaut .169
description: Doesn’t matter if skies are clear or storms roll in, .169 will make it to the other side with steady stride. If that calm confidence weren’t enough, this Cryptonaut knows how to brighten any forecast with undeniable charm.

name: Cryptonaut .170
description: .170 can climb just about anything. Mountain, building, waterfall- you name it, this Cryptonaut can conquer it. Well aware of his strength, he’s ready for any challenge at a moment’s notice.

name: Cryptonaut .171
description: .171 doesn’t blink when faced with a blazing, out of control fire. Tackling any problem with serenity and grace, no matter how massive, this Cryptonaut can handle it every single time and those around her rest assured knowing it.

name: Cryptonaut .172
description: The only weapon .172 will pull out is that sharp humor of his. Eager to make everyone laugh, this Cryptonaut is on duty to make sure all are having a good time.

name: Cryptonaut .173
description: Always aware of the quickest route to the destination, .173 never lets a letter arrive late. He knows the Cryptonauts depend on efficient communication, and that’s what makes this cryptonaut an honorable civil servant.

name: Cryptonaut .174
description: No one knows if it’s her serene nature, or unwavering belief that what’s meant to happen will, but .174 embraces the bull running at her with arms wide open. This Cryptonaut is ready for whatever comes charging at her.

name: Cryptonaut .175
description: Everyone is alway welcome at .175’s apiary, especially if you’re down for a good bee joke. This Cryptonaut handles the bees with grace and is in no rush to see results which is why they always make incredible amounts of honey.

name: Cryptonaut .176
description: Never one to miss the moment, you can always count on .176 to guide every arrival with perfect timing. Better yet, give this Cryptonaut a runway, and watch those signals shine the path home. A true champion of direction in every sense of the word.

name: Cryptonaut .177
description: This skillful daredevil knows he can always reach higher and learn tricks he’s never even seen. .177 is very modest considering how brilliant of a biker he is, luckily this modesty doesn’t translate to pessimism since he knows his future can only get brighter from here.

name: Cryptonaut .178
description: With moves no one has ever seen, .178 is an ingenious artist blowing everyone’s mind away. Luckily, this Cryptonaut is as unpretentious as they come. He doesn’t let the talent of his elastic body go to his head.

name: Cryptonaut .179
description: .179 knows she will make it to the end of the longest tightrope and that’s much before anyone can walk the same distance. This Cryptonaut knows that being bold is the only way to accomplish her lofty goals.

name: Cryptonaut .180
description: .180 knows that what he puts out into the universe will come swinging back at him, and that just doesn’t go for his boomerang. This Cryptonaut is a believer of good cosmic karma and understands that a great way to achieve that is to keep others laughing.

name: Cryptonaut .181
description: With the ability to play any tune, .181 is always open to requests. He’s eager to learn new chords and captivate the audience because this Cryptonaut can win anyone over with his unforgettable, unique sound.

name: Cryptonaut .182
description: .182 is always overjoyed to share his latest tricks. He even teaches others his secrets and never holds back. This Cryptonaut is a kind yo-yo master who shares his skill with others in hopes they will enjoy the beauty of the yo-yo sport as well.

name: Cryptonaut .183
description: .183 sees beautiful sights, others can’t even imagine. The magic isn’t in her binoculars, but in her mind. This creative genius is also very giving as she uses her gift to contribute to the design of the universe.

name: Cryptonaut .184
description: Always shaking to a cheerful melody, .184 is determined to be the moon’s go-to party entertainer. This Cryptonaut always brings his best to the celebration because his job is to make sure every person in the room is having the time of their lives.

name: Cryptonaut .185
description: Her spinning hula hoop mesmerizes all around .185. She then uses that fact to collect donations and give them to those in need. This Cryptonaut is as benevolent as they come.

name: Cryptonaut .186
description: A master builder, .186 lets intelligence reign. He uses his blocks to depict a modern perspective only he can see and doesn’t ask for anything in return. This Cryptonaut is simply happy to be a brick in the final product that is TTM’s future.

name: Cryptonaut .187
description: This social butterfly doesn’t need wings, she has a propeller cap that takes her from friend group to friend group. Everyone loves .187 due to her giving, compassionate spirit.

name: Cryptonaut .188
description: Known as the “kingpin”, .188 is known to hit the center pin every time, and he makes solid strikes doing it! We’re not just talking about fallen pins- this Cryptonaut’s jokes take everyone out with a single roll.

name: Cryptonaut .189
description: .189 always knows the smoothest way from point A to B and is ready for the next run. Known for staying aware of every move around her and never missing the right moment to act, this dependable Cryptonaut rides every path with confidence and control.

name: Cryptonaut .190
description: There’s no point in even trying an extreme sport like fire dancing if you aren’t sure of your capabilities. .190 knows that and is ready to manipulate the flames into any form as he takes his work very seriously. Thank goodness for that because not everyone can handle this heat.

name: Cryptonaut .191
description: Always around to offer a gentle breeze, .191 is a kind soul who’s charity is her trademark. This Cryptonaut always knows the right thing to do and is not afraid to share this insight with others.

name: Cryptonaut .192
description: Always keeping it light with his incredible slinky tricks, .192 is a true artist but will never admit it. This Cryptonaut knows that the real fun is amongst the “amateurs” even though his skill is far beyond that level.

name: Cryptonaut .193
description: This yogee understands that his practice is an exploration of all that his body is capable of and .193 is able to do it all. Known as the pretzel, this cryptonaut can move in magnificent ways.

name: Cryptonaut .194
description: Somehow, all the pieces just fit together with .194. This Cryptonaut is always looking for the quickest way to see the bigger picture. Her intelligence allows her to work backwards from confusing problems to arrive at a simple solution.

name: Cryptonaut .195
description: Definitely the loudest of the crowd, .195 is dedicated to supporting those around him, which is what makes him so admired and loved. Nothing can stop this Cryptonaut from being not only a fan, but a true team player.

name: Cryptonaut .196
description: .196 trusts his gut when it comes to most things in life and horse jockeying is no different. The fastest racer any planet has ever seen, this Cryptonaut has a gift of pace and keeping hope alive, even when far behind the rest.

name: Cryptonaut .197
description: Lights, camera, action! .197 is the movie star everyone loves to watch, regardless of the fact his camera is always rolling. This Cryptonaut loves to capture the magnificent sights of the moon and everyone loves him for it.

name: Cryptonaut .198
description: .198’s unwavering belief in the goodness of all Cryptonauts is as unbreakable as the chains in his hands. This Cryptonaut is also a master at setting up contraptions that lift and transfer power, making him crucial to the moon’s development.

name: Cryptonaut .199
description: With a knack for geography (of every planet), .199 uses her smarts and instincts to map out ideal travel routes for all. Not only that, she can pinpoint unexplored locations, making her part of the first step when it comes to discovering unchartered territory.

name: Cryptonaut .200
description: .200 sees how any situation will play out well before it does. With his creative visions, this Cryptonaut directs the group’s way to overcome obstacles. After all, what good story doesn’t have its setbacks? That is of course if the protagonist wins in the end and .200 makes sure of it.
